scope: Source and symbolic reasoning only. No geometry, pair census, numeric solver/native execution, scientific imports, prepared tests/functions or obstruction result.

metric.definitions: S=|a|^2+|b|^2>0; T=|a cross b|^2>0; n=(a cross b)/sqrt(T); c=z*n+t with t normal-orthogonal; w=z^2; r=|t|^2.
metric.tangential_bound_reason: Maximize 900*T*w/(T+S*w)-S-w over w>=0; derivative zero at w=29*T/S, giving841*T/S-S.
metric.shifted_ball_valid: For certified nonnegative normal roots, center centroid+mid(height_low,height_high)*oriented_n and squared radius (2/3)*(841*T/S-S)+(height_high-height_low)^2/4 contains the necessary cylinder.

simpler_centroid_ball.proof: w/(T+S*w) increases for w>=0, while w<=u. Thus Q^2 <= 9*T*u/[(S+u)*(T+S*u)], yielding the same quadratic with u.
simpler_centroid_ball.necessary_ball: center=exact fixed-triple centroid; physical radius squared=2*u_plus/3
simpler_centroid_ball.source_rational_invariants: S=(2/3)*sum of three fixed-edge squared lengths; T=(4/3)*squared raw fixed-edge cross product.
simpler_centroid_ball.isolated_feasibility_condition: T/S^2>=1/841, equivalent to fixed-triangle normalized Q^2>=4/841. Otherwise the existing isolated-apex ceiling already obstructs target0.1.
simpler_centroid_ball.positive_roots: Under that condition,899*T-S^2>0 and discriminant>=0, giving two positive roots.
simpler_centroid_ball.no_sqrt_upper_bound: u_plus < (899*T-S^2)/S, since the other root is positive. Multiplying by2/3 gives a rational squared outer radius without square roots.
simpler_centroid_ball.certified_refinement: Any tighter upper bound must enclose the upper root using exact rational/algebraic or outward-certified square-root arithmetic; informative float approximations alone do not certify disjointness.

sign_and_corner_order: The positive target requires z>0 relative to the parity-correct normal. Moving the free corner last while retaining native orientation requires an even tetrahedral permutation, or reversing two base corners when parity is odd.

Magnitude squared is invariant under tetrahedron corner permutations for this regular ideal reference. The centroid-ball invariants depend only on the fixed triangle; discarding signed-side information enlarges the necessary set safely.
Three boundary-coordinate nodes are not automatically a recorded exterior surface face. The existing helper preserves this distinction.

exact_pair_disjointness.premises: Two balls constrain the same source-tagged apex, with identical frozen fixed-coordinate policy and nonnegative rational squared upper radii U1,U2. D is exact squared distance between their exact centroids.
exact_pair_disjointness.reason: These strict inequalities are equivalent to D>(sqrt(U1)+sqrt(U2))^2, so the closed outer balls are disjoint. Squaring requires the A>0 guard.
exact_pair_disjointness.conclusion: No shared point can satisfy both necessary conditions, hence those fixed-triple cells cannot jointly reach real-arithmetic signed SICN>=0.1 under that fixed-connectivity/fixed-coordinate policy.
exact_pair_disjointness.inconclusive: Equality, touching or overlap is inconclusive. Pairwise overlap does not prove all balls intersect; any intersection still need not satisfy true individual quality regions or other cell constraints.
